card.name: Month names after the word On
card.fires_on: A month name, mostly January or March, right after "On" or "on" at the start of a dated event, as in "On March 4". It fires before the day number and year.

modes.label: Sentence-opening On + month
modes.description: The month follows a capitalized "On" that begins a sentence or heading about a past event.

modes.label: Mid-sentence on + month
modes.description: The month follows a lowercase "on" inside a sentence that gives the date of an event.

card.plain: It lights up on the month name in a phrase like "On March 4" when a text gives the date of an event.
